name: 19-inch alloys
blurb: Polished multi-spoke 19s, well outside the factory fitment.
body: Four inches over the largest wheel Toyota offered on this car. That changes the speedo, the effective gearing, the unsprung mass and — because the car also sits low — whether the factory alignment figures apply at all.
watch: The manual quotes alignment at a reference ride height of 190 mm front and 224 mm rear, measured to the lower arm bolt centres. A lowered car does not meet that, so the book camber and toe figures are a starting point, not a target.
Balance limit is 8.0 g. A 19-inch wheel is far less forgiving of being out than a 15 was.
Tyre runout limit 1.0 mm; hub backlash 0.05 mm; hub deviation 0.07 mm. Worth checking if you have any vibration.
Cold pressures on the label are for a 205/55R15. A much lower-profile tyre on a wider rim wants its own pressure, not the door sticker.
